notes: Mobile Harness Code v1.22.0 — Utility Tools, a new optional developer stack. Adds five everyday command-line helpers on demand (jq, ripgrep, fd, zip, unzip) installed through the existing DevStack installer inside the Ubuntu 20.04 runtime, available to the terminal and all four coding agents. fd is exposed via the conventional fd symlink. tree is omitted because it is GPL-2.0 (outside the MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD license policy). No new Gradle dependencies. Signed (V2) with the unchanged production certificate.
